calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for OLX India
calls.summary: The discussion centered around the evaluation of GrowthBook for OLX, emphasizing integration capabilities and pricing to enhance experimentation processes. Anshul Bansal outlined the current testing of GrowthBook’s SDK, highlighting the importance of GDPR compliance and data privacy. James Shannon elaborated on the technical aspects of GrowthBook, such as local SDK randomization and the handling of experiment data, ensuring no PII is stored. The team is exploring use cases to optimize the package purchase funnel and discussed the potential ROI of significant revenue uplift. Licensing options were clarified, with a focus on the differences between Pro and Enterprise plans, and the importance of data privacy was underscored, particularly around self-hosting. Next steps involve internal compliance review and potential trials of GrowthBook’s Pro cloud plan.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, OLX, experimentation, feature flags, GDPR compliance, pricing tiers
